payload.summary: The council's tenant satisfaction measures for 2025/26 — 26 measures the Regulator of Social Housing requires every landlord to publish, from a survey of 1,002 Norwich tenants between May 2025 and March 2026. Three quarters of tenants, 75.3%, were satisfied with the overall service, up from 71.1% the year before. Satisfaction with how complaints are handled was 30.0%. The council publishes no target for any of the 26.
